_comment: Global do-not-contact store, keyed on contact identity (email/phone/domain) so an opt-out survives across campaigns even if the same business is re-scraped under a new id. Written on opt-out and self-healed by scripts/lib/do-not-contact.js syncFromState(). Checked at ingestion (sheet-import) and every send lane (pitcher, drip). Entries are appended, never silently removed.
